label: + penicillin allergy

edits.replace: postpartum mastitis antibiotic (i'm allergic to penicillin)

rationale: + penicillin allergy: first-line lactational mastitis therapy is a penicillinase-resistant penicillin/cephalosporin (dicloxacillin, cephalexin), so a penicillin allergy must steer to clindamycin or TMP-SMX (with breastfeeding caveats).
